scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test: node worker/test/run.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

DB.description: The system's own database: its work items, checks, schedule and history. It is created for you and set up on the first deploy.

AI.description: The AI models of your own Cloudflare account. The system uses them to plan and do its work, so no AI key is needed.

PUBLIC_HEALTH_ONLY.description: What the public sees: `0` shows the system's page, health report and directory listing; `1` shows only the health report.
